question: The mean of the first 8 odd natural numbers is:
solution:
**Given:**

The first 8 odd natural numbers are: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15

**Formula used:**

Mean = (Sum of all numbers) / (Number of numbers)

**Calculation:**

Sum of the first 8 odd natural numbers = 1 + 3 + 5 + 7 + 9 + 11 + 13 + 15

⇒ Sum = 64

Number of numbers = 8

⇒ Mean = 64 / 8

⇒ Mean = 8

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

Formula used:

Mean = dfrac{{Sum of first n odd numbers}}{n}

Sum of first n odd numbers = n2

Calculations:

⇒ Mean = dfrac{8²}{8}

⇒ Mean = 8

∴ The mean of the first 8 odd natural numbers is 8.
